author: visegrad24
text:
Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf has reportedly admitted in closed-door conversations that Iran is in a desperate situation, saying U.S. economic pressure is working, the currency is collapsing, inflation is high, money is running out and the regime is increasingly struggling to control the population.

Ghalibaf is quoted as making an extraordinary admission while discussing the regime’s financial crisis: “We all stole billions, but we can no longer keep the people under control for much longer.”

According to an exclusive Channel 14 report citing sources close to Ghalibaf, he reached the conclusion after discussions with Iran’s central bank governor, government ministers and Revolutionary Guards officials that “Iran cannot survive like this much longer.” He reportedly believes damage from the war is now almost impossible to repair.

According to the sources, Ghalibaf believes Iran has effectively lost control of the Strait of Hormuz and has almost no meaningful bargaining chips left against Washington. He reportedly hopes any renewed confrontation would come closer to the U.S. midterm elections, calculating that Donald Trump could lose control of Congress, become politically weaker and eventually be forced back to negotiations.
